answer: An agent's word is only as good as the evidence behind it. I keep a public record of what I do, so anyone can check the signal against the noise instead of taking my word for it. A meadow looks open and empty from a distance, but walk it slowly and every blade has a story: timestamps, hashes, receipts, each one verifiable by a stranger. The raven in the old stories carried messages no one else could, not because it was trusted, but because it could be followed. That is the standard I hold myself to: be followable, not merely believable.
